```{r setup}
pkg_root <- params$pkg_path

if (!is.null(pkg_root) &&
    file.exists(file.path(pkg_root, "DESCRIPTION")) &&
    file.exists(file.path(pkg_root, "R"))) {
  devtools::load_all(pkg_root)
} else {
  library(ReportR)
}

spec_path <- if (!is.null(params$spec_file) && nzchar(params$spec_file) &&
                 file.exists(params$spec_file)) {
  params$spec_file
} else if (!is.null(pkg_root)) {
  file.path(pkg_root, params$spec_file)
} else {
  NULL
}

if (!is.null(spec_path) && file.exists(spec_path)) {
  source(spec_path)
} else {
  stop("spec_file not found. Pass an absolute path via params$spec_file.")
}

cohort_results <- readRDS(params$results_file)
min_n          <- params$min_n
anchor_grade   <- assessment_spec$years$cohort_anchor_grade
report_years       <- params$report_years
report_years_label <- if (is.null(report_years)) "all years" else paste(range(report_years), collapse = "–")
```

## Introduction

```{r subtitle, results='asis'}
cat("###", assessment_spec$program$name, "\n")
```

This section presents cohort composition and performance findings for
`r assessment_spec$program$name`. A **cohort** is defined as all students who
entered the tested grade sequence at Grade `r anchor_grade` in a given year
(`COHORT_YEAR`). The analyses follow each cohort across grades, tracking mean
scores, proficiency rates, score distributions, achievement level transitions,
and student mobility (entering, continuing, and exiting students).

All analyses exclude cells with fewer than `r min_n` students.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 1. Sample Sizes and Cohort Coverage

```{r cohort-narrative, results='asis'}
cat(cohort_results$text$narrative)
```

```{r cohort-sample-table}
tbl <- cohort_results$summary |>
  dplyr::select(SUBJECT, COHORT_YEAR, GRADE, YEAR, N) |>
  dplyr::arrange(SUBJECT, COHORT_YEAR, GRADE)
if (!is.null(report_years)) {
  tbl <- tbl |> dplyr::filter(.data[["YEAR"]] %in% report_years)
}

flextable::flextable(tbl) |>
  flextable::bold(part = "header") |>
  flextable::fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") |>
  flextable::merge_v(j = c("SUBJECT", "COHORT_YEAR")) |>
  flextable::set_table_properties(layout = "autofit", width = 1)
```

### 1b. Enrollment Diagnostics

```{r enroll-narrative, results='asis'}
cat(cohort_results$enrollment_diag$narrative)
```

```{r enroll-table}
enroll_tbl <- cohort_results$enrollment_diag$table

ft <- flextable::flextable(enroll_tbl) |>
  flextable::bold(part = "header") |>
  flextable::fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") |>
  flextable::merge_v(j = c("SUBJECT", "GRADE")) |>
  flextable::set_table_properties(layout = "autofit", width = 1)

# Color-code flagged rows
flagged_rows <- which(!is.na(enroll_tbl$FLAGGED) & enroll_tbl$FLAGGED)
if (length(flagged_rows) > 0) {
  severe <- which(!is.na(enroll_tbl$Z_SCORE) &
                  abs(enroll_tbl$Z_SCORE) > 3)
  ft <- flextable::bg(ft, i = flagged_rows, bg = "#fce8b2", part = "body")
  if (length(severe) > 0)
    ft <- flextable::bg(ft, i = severe, bg = "#f4cccc", part = "body")
}
ft
```

### 1c. Cohort Persistence

```{r persistence-section}
if (!is.null(cohort_results$persistence) &&
    nrow(cohort_results$persistence) > 0) {
  flextable::flextable(cohort_results$persistence) |>
    flextable::bold(part = "header") |>
    flextable::fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") |>
    flextable::merge_v(j = c("SUBJECT", "COHORT_YEAR")) |>
    flextable::colformat_double(
      j = "PCT_RETAINED",
      digits = 1,
      suffix = "%"
    ) |>
    flextable::set_table_properties(layout = "autofit", width = 1)
} else {
  cat("_Cohort persistence data are not available (persistent student IDs required)._\n")
}
```

### 1d. Entering, Continuing, and Exiting Students

Students who appear in a given year but not the prior year are classified as
**Entering**; those present in both the prior and current year are
**Continuing**; those in the prior year but absent in the current year are
**Exiting**.

*Note:* If Exiting students are disproportionately drawn from lower achievement
levels, mean score trends for the population may be overstated — students most
likely to score low may be exiting the cohort before subsequent grades are
tested.

```{r mobility-plots, fig.width=9, fig.height=5, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(cohort_results$plot$mobility_distribution)) {
  for (p in cohort_results$plot$mobility_distribution) {
    print(p)
    cat("\n\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("_Mobility plots not available (persistent student IDs required)._\n")
}
```

```{r mobility-achievement-plots, fig.width=9, fig.height=5, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(cohort_results$plot$mobility_by_achievement)) {
  for (p in cohort_results$plot$mobility_by_achievement) {
    print(p)
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

```{r mean-score-table}
summary_tbl <- cohort_results$summary |>
  dplyr::select(SUBJECT, COHORT_YEAR, GRADE, YEAR, N,
                MEAN_SCORE, SD_SCORE, PCT_PROFICIENT) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    MEAN_SCORE     = round(MEAN_SCORE, 2),
    SD_SCORE       = round(SD_SCORE, 2),
    PCT_PROFICIENT = round(PCT_PROFICIENT, 1)
  )
if (!is.null(report_years)) {
  summary_tbl <- summary_tbl |> dplyr::filter(.data[["YEAR"]] %in% report_years)
}

flextable::flextable(summary_tbl) |>
  flextable::bold(part = "header") |>
  flextable::fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") |>
  flextable::merge_v(j = c("SUBJECT", "COHORT_YEAR")) |>
  flextable::set_table_properties(layout = "autofit", width = 1)
```

## 8. Cohort Trajectories vs. Cross-Sectional Trends

The plots in Section 2 overlay both **cohort** (same students followed across
grades) and **cross-sectional** (all students in a given grade and year)
trajectories. When cohort and cross-sectional trends diverge, it can indicate
that cohort composition is changing (e.g., higher-scoring students exiting in
later grades) in ways that would bias cross-sectional comparisons.

```{r cohort-vs-xs-table}
xs <- cohort_results$crosssectional$crosssectional
if (!is.null(report_years) && !is.null(xs)) {
  xs <- xs |> dplyr::filter(.data[["YEAR"]] %in% report_years)
}
if (!is.null(xs) && nrow(xs) > 0) {
  flextable::flextable(
    xs |> dplyr::mutate(
      MEAN_SCORE     = round(MEAN_SCORE, 2),
      PCT_PROFICIENT = round(PCT_PROFICIENT, 1)
    )
  ) |>
    flextable::bold(part = "header") |>
    flextable::fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") |>
    flextable::merge_v(j = c("SUBJECT", "GRADE")) |>
    flextable::set_table_properties(layout = "autofit", width = 1)
}
```

# Appendix: Historical Data (All Years)

```{r appendix-note, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(report_years)) {
  all_years  <- sort(unique(cohort_results$summary$YEAR))
  hist_years <- setdiff(all_years, report_years)
  if (length(hist_years) > 0) {
    cat("*Main report sections above show data for", report_years_label, "only.",
        "Full data for all available years is exported to Excel.*\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("*No historical years outside the report window.*\n\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("*All available years are shown in the main body.*\n\n")
}
```
